subject: [PATCH RFC v4 08/12] selftests/mm: cover /proc/pid/mem access to VM_PFNMAP memory

2026-07-24.patch_summary: This patch adds two tests to the selftests/mm/pfnmap.c file to cover reading VM_PFNMAP memory through /proc/pid/mem. The first test, procmem_cow_read, maps a private and writable file, writes to a copy-on-write (COW) page, and then reads it back through /proc/self/mem. Without the struct-page path in get_user_page_vma(), this read would fall back to generic_access_phys() and ioremap of a COWed RAM page is rejected. The second test, procmem_pfn_read, reads a raw PFN back through ->access(). This patch exercises __access_remote_vm() two ways: through the struct-page path in get_user_page_vma() and through vma->vm_ops->access(), which ioremaps the PFN.
